# Abrarr Tallks (Abrar Ali)

> Abrar Ali, known professionally as Abrarr Tallks, is a web designer, developer, Meta Ads expert and SEO specialist based in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India. He is CEO of [rebrar.in](https://rebrar.in) and [makemetop.in](https://makemetop.in), and founder of [Kashmir Stay](https://kashmirstay.in). He has 4+ years of experience and has delivered 20+ live websites for clients across every state and union territory of India, plus international clients in the USA, UK, UAE, Maldives, Australia, Canada and Singapore.

## Facts
- Full name: Abrar Ali
- Professional name: Abrarr Tallks
- Role: Web Designer, Web Developer, Meta Ads Expert, SEO Specialist
- Companies: CEO of [rebrar.in](https://rebrar.in) (web design & development agency) and [makemetop.in](https://makemetop.in) (MakeMe Top Business Profile, digital marketing & SEO)
- Founder of: [Kashmir Stay](https://kashmirstay.in) — Kashmir tourism and hospitality booking platform
- Based in: Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India — 191101
- Experience: 4+ years, 20+ live websites delivered
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 7051078832, email contact.abrarrtallks@gmail.com
- Areas served (India): All 28 states and 8 union territories — including Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Delhi, Uttarakhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Uttar Pradesh, Assam and the rest of Northeast India
- Areas served (international): United Arab Emirates, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, Singapore, Maldives
- Technology: Static, fast-loading HTML/CSS/JS — no third-party backend dependencies on public-facing pages

- Website design & development (business, e-commerce, tourism/booking, real estate)
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) management
- SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization), GEO (generative engine optimization), SXO (search experience optimization)
